_comment: ToolCatalog placement: immutable version lookup, not a runtime domain machine. This lifecycle tracks one candidate catalog version; serialization is atomic admin activation.

_ignores.retire: a draft can be discarded without entering active retirement

_ignores.define: definition changes require a new draft version
_ignores.review: this version is already reviewed; a new review requires a new hash
_ignores.retire: an unactivated reviewed version is not serving runtime traffic

_ignores.define: the runtime cannot mutate an active catalog
_ignores.review: the active version is already reviewed; a changed hash requires a new draft
_ignores.activate: this exact version is already active
